title: DCLab Code: search inside sessions, Y/N keys, Mac notifications, per-file undo, a daily spending cap
request: Make sure the store runs on a schedule, then build Y/N keys, Mac notifications, per-file diff with undo, and a daily spending cap.
plan: Make every decision faster, since each is a label
Let the person take back one file's change, and keep that correction

decisions.decision: Undo saves the file's current content before restoring it
decisions.why: an undo must itself be undoable; in a Here session it also drops the person's own edits in that file, and the confirm says so

decisions.decision: A native notification through a WebKit message handler
decisions.why: WebKit shows no page notifications in the Mac app

decisions.decision: The SDK gets the smaller of the session's and today's cap
decisions.why: its cap counts only one query's spend

change: Y/N/A keys on the oldest waiting card; window.webkit.messageHandlers.dclab for notifications and the Dock badge; POST /api/git/undo with a backup, recorded as the person's undo; budgetUsdPerDay; GET /api/search.

findings.defect: palette hover redrew the list under the pointer
findings.scenario: a page test's click on a search hit retried for 30 seconds
findings.cause: mouseenter rebuilt every row, replacing the one being clicked

findings.scenario: its second session asked a permission the test never answered

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every server, unit and page test passes
measurements.result: 47 passed; the Mac smoke test sees the notification handler
limits: the notification itself needs the person's permission on first use

outcome: Deciding is faster, the app says when it waits, a file's change can be taken back as a kept correction, and spend has a daily cap.
lessons: A UI element that rebuilds itself on hover breaks clicks
risks: undo in a Here session drops the person's own uncommitted edits in that file
